Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is a Chemical Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) assay using the BS3 crosslinker. While not a traditional TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) assay, XL-MS often routes through similar structural proteomics modifiers (mod_tpp) or specialized XL-MS workflows in some routing schemas. Labeling is LFQ as no isobaric or metabolic tags were used.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (XL-MS) was performed on purified dynactin complexes. The material was derived from both native pig brain purification and recombinant expression in Sf9 cells (human constructs), indicating a mixed-species context for the overall study, though the specific XL-MS dataset PXD020084 focuses on the purified dynactin complex.

evidence: To validate our structures, we crosslinked dynactin with bis(sulfosuccinimidyl)suberate (BS3) and identified the crosslinked residues using cross-linking mass spectrometry (PRIDE dataset PXD020084).
